description: Amendment of the Water Resources Board Act, No.29 of 1964 for strengthening the regulation of the Water Resources Board
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-04-06 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Water Resources Board was established by the Water Resources Board Act No. 29 of 1964 to secure, conserve, and ensure the legal basis required to improve the qualitative and quantitative factors of groundwater and resultant surface water bodies and to facilitate the management and the prevention of water pollution. As per the provisions of the said Act, Orders have been issued from time to time regarding the procedures to be followed in the use of natural water springs or groundwater for commercial purposes and projects. However, it has been observed that there are problems in implementing the law regarding complaints filed with regard to the groundwater extraction in a manner that causes hardships to the public. Therefore, the need has been identified to amend the Water Resources Board Act No. 29 of 1964 to expand the role of the Water Resources Board to systematically regulate the activities such as misuse and excessive extraction of groundwater and resultant surface water. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Environment to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare an amending Bill for the said purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.
